newsitem.title: USA: American Radio to exchange stations.
newsitem.headline: American Radio to exchange stations.

text.p: American Radio Systems Corp said Friday it reached an agreement with EXCL Communications involving the exchange of four stations in Portland, Ore., Sacramento and the Bay Area of San Francisco/San Jose.
EXCL is a unit of Latin Communications Group Inc.

American said it will convey radio station KSSJ-FM in Sacramento and the physical assets and FCC License of KBAY-FM in the Bay Area to EXCL Communications Inc in exchange for KINK-FM in Portland and the transmission facilities and FCC license of KBRG-FM serving the Bay Area.
American said it will retain, on a different frequency, the call letters and format of KBAY.
Pursuant to the agreement, American Radio said it will receive about $2,000,000 in cash from EXCL and will be issued 150,000 shares of the common stock of Latin Communications Group.
American Radio also said it commenced an offer to purchase any and all of American's (formerly EZ Communications Inc.) outstanding 9-3/4 percent Senior Subordinated Notes due 2005.
